project.title: Why do we open our phone and forget why?
project.description: A short Persian educational motion-graphics explainer.
project.visual_focus: Persian typography, animated diagrams, and everyday objects

narration.script: نمونه متن گویندگی برای تست قرارداد پروژه.

scenes.visual: A hand reaches for a phone; the screen lights up and the original intention appears as a fading thought bubble.
A simple animated attention diagram shows an intention being displaced by a notification.
The phone moves aside while three concise visual takeaways assemble on screen.
